query: SELECT count(*) AS "count!" FROM central.runs r JOIN central.recovery_epoch_workspaces w ON w.epoch_generation = $1 AND w.workspace_id = r.workspace_id JOIN central.recovery_epochs e ON e.epoch_generation = w.epoch_generation AND e.coordinator_domain = $3 WHERE r.workspace_id = $2 AND r.reconciled_epoch < $1 AND (r.created_at < w.watermark_created_at OR (r.created_at = w.watermark_created_at AND r.id <= w.watermark_run_id))
